audit.why: Lane difficulty 7/10 HARD matches a 43.83% Emerald+ win rate and the kit read: Poppy is a point-and-click melee with a wall-stun (Heroic Charge, 475 range, 14/13/12/11/10s) against a pre-6 melee mage with no escape. Early is conceded, Level 6 is the only even window, and her Steadfast Presence keeps answering the blink into the late game.

audit.whatIsWrong: content whys[3] and whys[4] are swapped against the stage order. whys[3] (Levels 4-5) described Riftwalk coming online; whys[4] (Level 6) described the pre-6 survival grind. full.phases[3]/[4] have it the right way round, so the two layers contradicted each other on where the Level 6 spike lands.
audit.why: Stage order is Level 1, Level 2, Level 3, Levels 4-5, Level 6, First item, Two+ items. win[4] is 'Skill' — the Level 6 slot — but whys[4] told the reader to keep farming and never all-in, which is the Levels 4-5 instruction.
audit.corrected: whys[3] now carries the Levels 4-5 survival text with Heroic Charge's real cooldown; whys[4] carries the Level 6 Riftwalk spike keyed to Steadfast Presence's 20s cooldown. Sides and counts unchanged.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two ability-interaction errors. (a) tradeGood / dosFull[1] told you to walk out of a trade 'as the shield absorbs his counter' and dosFull[1].t said 'Absorb his magic poke with Q' — Null Sphere's shield absorbs magic damage only, and Poppy's entire damage profile (Hammer Shock, Heroic Charge, autos, Keeper's Verdict) is physical, so the shield absorbs none of her counter. (b) breakdown.late said 'Q-silence the counterplay' — Null Sphere has no silence; Riot's text says it interrupts channels.
audit.why: Riot's Null Sphere description: 'fires an orb of void energy at a target, dealing damage and interrupting channels. The excess energy forms around himself, granting a temporary shield that absorbs magic damage.' Nothing about silence, and the shield is magic-only. Poppy's kit has no magic damage source in Riot's text.
audit.corrected: Trade line now says her damage is physical so the Q shield absorbs none of it; the late line now says Null Sphere cuts a channel instead of silencing. Added the real payoff: Keeper's Verdict is a channelled hammer strike cast at 500 range, and Null Sphere reaches 650 and interrupts channels — Q the wind-up from outside her range and the knock-up never lands.

audit.whatIsWrong: No real cooldown numbers anywhere — the pages said 'wait for Steadfast Presence' without ever saying how long you are waiting.
audit.why: Steadfast Presence is 20/18/16/14/12s over a 400-unit radius; Heroic Charge is 14/13/12/11/10s at 475 range. Those two clocks are the whole matchup.
audit.corrected: Added the 20s Steadfast Presence and the Heroic Charge cooldown into whys[3], whys[4], spikes[2] and wants.foe[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: Rune Setup justified the page with 'Fleet plus Q shield is how you survive the bully phase'.
audit.why: Same magic-only shield error as point 4 — against an all-physical champion the Q shield is not the survival tool; Bone Plating and Second Wind are.
audit.corrected: Rune line now credits Bone Plating rather than the Q shield. Rune choices themselves are unchanged.

Stop trying to solo her; play for sidelane farm and let your team absorb her engage while you flank with stacked Riftwalk from an angle she is not facing.

notes: Kit-file flag misfire to be aware of across every Kassadin matchup: champ-data/_kits/kassadin.json tags Null Sphere (Q) with channel: 'interruptible — any CC cancels it', and _missing-interactions.json turns that into rows like 'Kassadin's Null Sphere (Q) is a channel — your Heroic Charge (E) cancels it outright.' Riot's own description says the opposite: Null Sphere interrupts channels, it is not one. I have not written any of those rows into the pages. The true version of the interaction runs the other way and is now on the page: Null Sphere interrupts Poppy's channelled Keeper's Verdict. Also note Poppy's Hammer Shock carries a 'grounding' derived flag that Riot's description does not support (it says slow + delayed explosion only) — no page text claims Q grounds. Poppy is female; the full layer is templated with male pronouns ('his kill pressure rots', 'Forget Mercs flip his CC math', 'Riftwalk onto him'). I fixed the pronouns inside the strings I rewrote, but breakdown.wave, breakdown.trading, report[3].t and dontsFull[2].t still misgender her.
